people.name: Ishmael
people.line: Son of Abraham and Hagar; father of Arab tribes.

people.name: Jehdeiah
people.line: Officer in charge of King David's donkeys

people.name: Meronothite
people.line: A term used to describe two individuals in the Bible

translations.web: and over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite; and over the donkeys was Jehdeiah the Meronothite; and over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagrite.
translations.bsb: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels. Jehdeiah the Meronothite was in charge of the donkeys.
translations.kjv: Over the camels also was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite:
translations.asv: and over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite: and over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagrite.
